book_long_title: The Living Planet: A Frame-Story of Earth and Soul
era: 4.5 billion years ago to the present
book_summary: A frame-story novel celebrating the Earth — its birth, its living systems, its beauty, and humanity's relationship to the planet that is our only home. Through a modern workshop frame and a sweeping narrative, the story traces the Earth's journey from a molten rock to a living world, weaving together geology, biology, and the deep question of our place within the web of life.

chapters.name: The Birth
chapters.chapter_summary: The Earth's birth from a cloud of dust and fire — the accretion of a planet, the cooling of its crust, and the first stirrings of a world that would one day hold life.

chapters.name: The Life
chapters.chapter_summary: The emergence of life in the ancient oceans — the first cells, the great oxygenation, and the long, patient journey from microbe to the diversity of the living world.

chapters.name: The Web
chapters.chapter_summary: The Earth as a single living system — the forests, the oceans, the atmosphere, and the intricate web of interdependence that sustains all life.

chapters.name: The Human
chapters.chapter_summary: The rise of humanity — the one creature that can see the whole Earth, and the tension between our power to harm and our power to heal.

chapters.name: The Home
chapters.chapter_summary: The Earth as our only home — the deep question of stewardship, and the hope that humanity will learn to live in harmony with the planet that gave us life.
